analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misunderstood the task by fixating on a single cube and misinterpreting the temporal structure of the video. It failed to perceive that all five cubes are rolled simultaneously in each of the five rolls, and instead hallucinated that only the second cube changes color over many frames. This led to a gross miscount of purple appearances (11 vs. correct 7) and ignored the contributions of the other four cubes entirely. The error stems from both perceptual misinterpretation of the scene and flawed temporal reasoning about the roll sequence.
